summary: Build systems thinking skills for complex project delivery through modelling, risk analysis, adaptive roadmaps, and practical governance exercises. Enrol today.
lede: For project directors, programme managers, PMO leaders and systems engineers, systems thinking maps dependencies across complex delivery. Participants practise diagnosing feedback and delays, modelling project flows, testing assumptions, linking risks to benefits and shaping adaptive roadmaps from project evidence. They also develop decision-ready material for governance reviews and executive reporting.
audienceIntro: This advanced systems thinking course is for professionals who already work with complex projects, programmes, portfolios, transformation initiatives, or major change and need stronger methods for diagnosing systemic delivery conditions. It suits experienced practitioners who can interpret project data and governance requirements but want to improve how they model uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and select interventions.
prerequisites: Advanced experience in project, programme, portfolio, transformation, systems engineering, risk, or PMO work is required. You should be able to interpret schedules, risk registers, governance reports, and benefits information. No programming is required. Vensim PLE and digital mapping exercises use guided templates rather than software development. Bring a laptop if possible. Course examples use anonymized or provided datasets, so no confidential organizational data is required.
